name: Prebaked Loader
description: Loads a pre-baked PackedScene of a DNA finding. The fast-load path: instead of running the grammar's Sim.build at every map open, load the .tscn that was baked once at curation time. Used for VR placements where per-instance parameter variation isn't needed — which is most of them.
theoreticalGrounding: A snapshot is enough when the snapshot is what was curated. Pre-baking trades render-time cost for storage cost — appropriate for findings whose value is the form, not the regeneration.

prebaked_loader.name: Prebaked Loader
prebaked_loader.description: Instantiates a saved PackedScene at scene_path. Parameter: scene_path (required, res://...). Used by promote_to_artifact.py when a baked .tscn exists at commons/generated/gallery_best_of/scenes/.
prebaked_loader.qfep_connection: S: a system state captured at one moment, replayed without recomputation.
